description: USDA AMS Market News (official MyMarketNews API): search the catalogue of livestock, grain, dairy, fruit/vegetable and other market reports by title, or pass a report slug id to get its latest published rows (prices, volumes, report date). Data straight from USDA; needs the owner's free MARS API key. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many reports or rows, 1 to 200 (default 25)

q.description: Words that must all appear in the report title (catalogue search; optional, max 100 characters)

section.description: With slug: which report section to return rows from, e.g. "Report Details" (default: the first section after the header; the catalogue lists each report's sections)

slug.description: Report slug id (number from the catalogue, e.g. 3926) to get its latest report: header, narrative and data rows instead of searching

name: search_usda_market_news
title: Search Usda Market News
